name: The University of Sydney
description: The University of Sydney is a public research university founded in 1850, the oldest university in Australia. It is a member of the Group of Eight and teaches across medicine and health, law, engineering, business, science and the arts.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website), and a Group of Eight university on both the Singapore Medical Council and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education (SILE) recognition lists.

livingCosts.notes: University of Sydney 'General living costs' table (monthly AUD, figures from the Study Australia cost-of-living calculator; the page gives no year, 2026 is the year it was read), range midpoints. Housing: accommodation $980-$3,500. Food: food and groceries $1,000-$2,500. Transport: $130-$800. Personal: mobile phone $30-$100 + lifestyle $350-$650 + gym $70-$100. The page also cites the older Home Affairs visa minimum of $24,505/yr.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts and Bachelor of Laws
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative Year 1 fee per 1.0 EFTSL (course 006441D), 2026 International Admission Guide; increases each year. Sydney offers the LLB only combined with another bachelor's degree; Commerce/Laws, Economics/Laws and Science/Laws are also A$56,300 (Engineering Honours/Laws is 6.5 years). Compulsory = 2026 SSAF A$186.50/semester full-time x 2. No official 2024/2025 fee list found online.

programmes.name: Juris Doctor
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative international full fee paying rate for Year 1 (48 credit points, 1.0 EFTSL) from the course page's fee data (sydney.edu.au/courses/courses/pc/juris-doctor.html loads it from this JSON); 144 credit points over 3 years. The same data lists 2027 at A$64,200. Compulsory = 2026 SSAF A$186.50/semester full-time x 2 (2027: A$193.00 x 2). Not available to student visa holders part-time. Fees increase each year.
